relations.rationale: The arrival time of latecomers is unrelated to competition rankings.
Latecomers arriving at noon is unrelated to members lining up for sandwiches.
Finn being in the same class as Bo doesn't determine whether Bo and Nell share a class.

If Finn is in the same class as Bo, and if Bo and Nell were in different classes, this is consistent but doesn't directly establish Finn's relation to Nell; however if Bo=Finn's class and Nell differs from Bo, that supports Finn also differing from Nell.
Finn and Bo sharing a class is unrelated to Nell's suggestions about track spacing.
The largest layout being a mountain scene supports the idea that it could also be positioned near the door, as both describe the same largest layout without conflict.
The description of the largest layout is unrelated to members comparing locomotives.
The largest layout being a mountain scene is unrelated to Zeno's steam engine display.
The largest layout being a mountain scene is consistent with and supports the general description of a miniature world spread across tables.
Bo not being in Nell's class is unrelated to Finn's competition placement.
Bo not being in Nell's class doesn't determine whether Finn is in Nell's class.
Members comparing locomotives throughout the afternoon supports the idea that Zeno displayed his steam engine as part of this comparison.
Members comparing locomotives is unrelated to competition rankings between Nell and Finn.
Members comparing locomotives throughout the afternoon is consistent with Nell offering suggestions about track spacing, but these are different activities without direct connection.
Zeno displaying a restored steam engine directly supports the claim that it took him months to finish, as both describe the same object.
Zeno displaying a restored steam engine is unrelated to Bo helping him adjust lighting on a smaller display.
The time taken to restore the steam engine is unrelated to when the refreshment table opens.
The steam engine restoration effort is unrelated to visitors arriving in the late afternoon.
Nell ranking third directly supports the claim that she ranked just behind Finn, assuming Finn ranked second.
Nell ranking third is consistent with and supports Finn placing second, since third comes just after second.
